name: HTML5 Maps
author: html5maps

sections.description:
HTML5 Maps lets you add interactive maps to your WordPress pages and posts. Choose a ready-made map of the world, a country or a region, then customize its colors, links and tooltip content in the WordPress dashboard.

Use clickable regions to guide visitors to location-specific pages, show information about the areas you serve, or organize content by country, state or province. Available maps include the World, USA, UK, Canada, France, Germany, Italy and more.

Create and manage multiple maps, give each map its own settings, and embed it with a shortcode. No coding is needed to configure a map or add it to your content.

Features

  • Ready-made world, country and regional maps
  • Multiple maps with individual settings and shortcodes
  • Responsive layout for desktop, tablet and mobile screens
  • Custom colors for regions and borders
  • Clickable regions with links to pages on your site or external websites
  • Tooltips with custom text and images
  • Additional region information displayed beside or below the map
  • Map preview in the WordPress dashboard

How to add a map

  1. Open HTML5 Maps in your WordPress dashboard and add a new map.
  2. Choose a map and customize its appearance and region settings.
  3. Copy the shortcode from the Maps list and paste it into a Shortcode block on a page or post.

Free version and map libraries

HTML5 Maps loads map libraries from the HTML5 Maps CDN at cdn.html5maps.com. An internet connection is required to load these libraries.

Free maps display a “Map by Fla-shop.com” attribution link, as required by the free map license terms.

Premium map plugins are available separately from Fla-shop.com. They remove the attribution link and include map libraries that you can host on your own server.

Translations

  • English – default, always included
  • German
  • Spanish (quierochat.com)
  • French (Josette Ragni)
  • Polish (jedstudio.me)
  • Portuguese (Portugal)
  • Brazilian Portuguese
  • Russian
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin and search for “HTML5 Maps” by Fla-shop.com.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Open HTML5 Maps > Maps, enter a map name, choose a map and click Add a new map.
  4. Configure the map in Main settings and Detailed settings, then save your changes.
  5. Copy the map’s shortcode from the Maps list and add it to a Shortcode block on a page or post.

To install from a ZIP file, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin, select the HTML5 Maps ZIP file, click Install Now and activate the plugin.

For manual installation, upload the html5-maps folder to /wp-content/plugins/, then activate HTML5 Maps on the Plugins screen and follow steps 3-5 above.
sections.faq:
How do I add a map to a page or post?

Copy the shortcode from HTML5 Maps > Maps and paste it into a Shortcode block in the WordPress editor. For example, [freehtml5map id="0"] displays the map with ID 0. Use the exact shortcode shown for your map. In the Classic Editor, paste the shortcode directly into the page or post content.

Can I customize a map without coding?

Yes. Use Main settings to adjust the map layout and borders. In Detailed settings, select a region to change its name, colors, link, tooltip content and additional information. Save your changes and use Map Preview to check the result.

Can I create more than one map?

Yes. Each map has its own settings and shortcode. Create and manage your maps on the Maps screen, then use the corresponding shortcode wherever you want to display each map.

How do I show information beside or below the map?

In Detailed settings, select a region, choose Show more info and enter the content in the Description editor. In Main settings, use Additional Info Area to position the content at the right or at the bottom of the map. The content appears when a visitor clicks that region.

What content can I add to the region information panel?

Use the Description editor to add formatted text, links and images from the WordPress Media Library. Supported media embeds and shortcodes depend on WordPress and any other plugins installed on your site.

Can I run JavaScript from a region’s URL field?

No. The URL field is intended for web links. JavaScript URLs are filtered and are not supported as a way to run custom code. Use Open a URL for links or Show more info to display region content.

Can I export and import map settings in the free version?

You can export settings by selecting one or more maps in the Maps list and clicking Export. Import is not available in this free plugin; the Import button is disabled.

Why does a map display a “Map by Fla-shop.com” link?

This attribution link is required by the free map license. Premium map plugins are available separately without this link. See the free map license terms and Premium plugin link in the Description section.

Do the maps need an internet connection?

Yes. The default setup loads map libraries from cdn.html5maps.com. Visitors need access to that CDN for the maps to load. If a map does not appear, check that its shortcode is correct and that the CDN scripts are not blocked by your browser, security settings or optimization plugins.
